method: Each claim is pre-registered in research/scope.ts with a falsifiability criterion fixed before the experiment. Evidence is mapped from the harness scorecard, the known-systems target assessment, the rigor modules, the significance ledger and the AI loop ledger onto those claim ids; a verdict can only be attached to an id that already existed, so the ledger records tests rather than post-hoc narratives.

verdicts.question: RQ4

criterion.statement: An intervention that leaves its target key unchanged, or moves it the wrong way, refutes the claim.

verdicts.detail: 13/13 declared interventions moved their target key in the predicted direction

verdicts.question: RQ6

criterion.statement: Any verdict in the loop ledger that is not traceable to a harness run over models A–J refutes the claim.

verdicts.detail: 5/5 loop verdicts adjudicated by deterministic code (4 by an actual benchmark run; the rest resolved to no model); the model proposed but never adjudicated

verdicts.question: RQ6

criterion.statement: A loop in which every round yields zero supported proposals refutes the claim.

verdicts.detail: 4/5 harness-scored proposals supported across the loop

verdicts.question: RQ7

criterion.statement: A steered trajectory whose aliveCount at the final tick is at or below the unsteered control refutes the claim.

verdicts.detail: steered aliveCount 54 vs unsteered control 139 (Δ -85); population 429 → 236, species 45 → 34
